name: contact_supervisor
description: Contact the parent/supervisor session for a blocking decision, structured interview, or progress update.

reason.description: need_decision waits for a supervisor decision; interview_request waits for structured JSON input; progress_update delivers a non-blocking update.

message.description: Question or progress update for the supervisor. Required and non-empty for need_decision and progress_update; optional when the interview object supplies the request.

interview.description: Structured interview request describing the expected JSON reply shape or questions (for example title and questions). Passed to the supervisor as an object; its JSON reply is returned as structuredReply, or structuredReplyParseError when parsing fails.
